info.name: filterID
info.description: Filter identifier.  Details in the Filter table.

info.name: surveyID
info.description: Survey identifier.  Details in the Survey table.

info.name: imageID
info.description: Unique image identifier.  Constructed as (100 * frameID + ccdID).

info.name: randomDetID
info.description: Random value drawn from the interval between zero and one.

info.name: obsTime
info.description: Modified Julian Date at the midpoint of the observation.

info.name: xPosErr
info.description: Error in PSF x center location.

info.name: yPosErr
info.description: Error in PSF y center location.

info.name: pltScale
info.description: Local plate scale at this location.

info.name: extNSigma
info.description: An extendedness measure based on the deviation between PSF and Kron (1980) magnitudes, normalized by the PSF magnitude uncertainty.

info.name: zp
info.description: Photometric zeropoint.  Necessary for converting listed fluxes and magnitudes back to measured ADU counts.

info.name: telluricExt
info.description: Estimated Telluric extinction due to non-photometric observing conditions.  Necessary for converting listed fluxes and magnitudes back to measured ADU counts.

info.name: expTime
info.description: Exposure time of the frame/exposure.  Necessary for converting listed fluxes and magnitudes back to measured ADU counts.

info.name: airMass
info.description: Airmass at midpoint of the exposure.  Necessary for converting listed fluxes and magnitudes back to measured ADU counts.

info.name: psfFluxErr
info.description: Error on flux from PSF fit.

info.name: psfCore
info.description: PSF core parameter k, where F = F0 / (1 + k r^2 + r^3.33).

info.name: psfQfPerfect
info.description: PSF weighted fraction of pixels totally unmasked.

info.name: psfChiSq
info.description: Reduced chi squared value of the PSF model fit.

info.name: psfLikelihood
info.description: Likelihood that this detection is best fit by a PSF.

info.name: momentM3C
info.description: Cosine of trefoil second moment term: r^2 cos(3 theta) = M_xxx - 3 * M_xyy.

info.name: momentM3S
info.description: Sine of trefoil second moment: r^2 sin (3 theta) = 3 * M_xxy - M_yyy.

info.name: momentM4C
info.description: Cosine of quadrupole second moment: r^2 cos (4 theta) = M_xxxx - 6 * M_xxyy + M_yyyy.

info.name: momentM4S
info.description: Sine of quadrupole second moment: r^2 sin (4 theta) = 4 * M_xxxy - 4 * M_xyyy.

info.name: apFluxErr
info.description: Error on flux in seeing-dependent aperture.

info.name: infoFlag
info.description: Information flag bitmask indicating details of the photometry.  Values listed in DetectionFlags.

info.name: infoFlag2
info.description: Information flag bitmask indicating details of the photometry.  Values listed in DetectionFlags2.

info.name: infoFlag3
info.description: Information flag bitmask indicating details of the photometry.  Values listed in DetectionFlags3.

info.name: distance
info.description: Angular separation between searched coordinates and center of observation
